messages:
Ava Patel: Hey sports crew—who's in for an office NBA playoff pool? Winner gets free lunch all week :taco:
Marcus Chen: I'm in. What's the buy-in? $10? :money_with_wings:
Lena Rodriguez: Count me in, but can we do a no-gambling version for tax/HR reasons? lol
Tomás Silva: I'll do $5 and bring snacks. Also can we stream the Cavs game in the lounge?
Priya Kapoor: I can reserve the lounge TV. Need HDMI adapter? Anyone? :tv:
Ava Patel: Scorebot just posted last season standings: `@scorebot standings 2025` — we can import that as seed info
Marcus Chen: Also let's do a prediction bracket on Google Sheets. I'll set it up and share.
Lena Rodriguez: Reminder: no betting on office devices per HR, so we can call it 'bragging rights pool' instead.
Tomás Silva: :thumbsup: Love it. If we get 8 ppl, winner gets lunch + a company sticker pack.
Priya Kapoor: Scheduled: Viewing party Friday 7pm. Bracket submissions due Thursday 5pm. Who's bringing food?
Ava Patel: I'll bring wings. Marcus — chips?
Marcus Chen: Chips and dip, on it.
Marcus Chen: @Lena wants to draft team picks 1-on-1 maybe for fun.
Lena Rodriguez: Yes please. Also can someone post link to the sheet?
Marcus Chen: done — https://drive.google.com/example-sheet (placeholder)
Tomás Silva: perfect :popcorn:
